caption: A toy pig, perched on a book, rolls to the left as if pushed by an unseen force. This causes a colorful pink ball adorned with whimsical patterns to wobble. The ball teeters on the edge of the white shelf before succumbing to gravity, tumbling off and landing with a gentle thud onto the wooden floor below. The pig remains stationary, its mischievous act complete.
